newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Liberals trailing in Newfoundland.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Liberals trailing in Newfoundland.

text.p: Canada's governing Liberals, who swept all seven seats in the Atlantic province of Newfoundland in the 1993 election, trailed in five of the province's seven electoral districts in early federal election results on Monday.

The Canadian Press news agency reported that the Conservatives led in four of Newfoundland's districts, with the left-wing New Democrats leading in another. Liberal incumbent George Baker was declared the winner in his seat, but Fisheries Minister Fred Mifflin was trailing in his Newfoundland district.
